summary: For the proposed coating shop storage/use of 60 gal flammable solvent, AB 2588 Air Toxics “Hot Spots” obligations are not triggered by a single statewide quantity threshold. CARB describes the program under H&S Code Part 6 and lists the relevant facility-subject and inventory chapters (H&S §§44320–44325, 44340–44346). CARB also states that H&S §44340 requires an inventory plan, and that under the EIC&G regulation (17 CCR §93300.5), an inventory plan is required “if requested by the district.” Because the facility county/location and therefore the controlling California air district are unknown, applicability is indeterminate: the district’s inclusion/request/prioritization rules must be confirmed. If the local air district requests an AB 2588 inventory plan/report for the coating source/solvent constituents, the facility may have AB 2588 reporting and risk-assessment duties.
title: H-AIR-AB2588 — California AB 2588 applicability cannot be determined without local air district; no statewide 60-gal solvent trigger identified
